title: Cardinals list Tyler Allgeier as RB1, Jeremiyah Love as RB2 on Week 1 depth chart

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cardinals list Tyler Allgeier as RB1, Jeremiyah Love as RB2 on Week 1 depth chart
sources.description: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said this week that he feels good about running back Jeremiyah Love being in the lineup against the Chargers in Week 1, but it remains to be seen what kind of role the rookie will play coming off of an ankle injury.
